descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-12 ER 4; TFA-94699 AC 5 · “A deleted med row, task, or Important Point never comes back unless re-dictated”.

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S07 Edit one, delete one, reload, re-save: the edit stays, the deleted point never comes back (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Editing one point and deleting another both work, in both modes, and the result is what is stored. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T3 A deleted Important Point never comes back unless the physician enters it again. (TFA-94699 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T5 Points are stored exactly as typed: text, case, punctuation, symbols and spacing, one card per typed point, nothing added. Deterministic: any single mismatch fails and is quoted typed vs stored; … (TFA-92590 AC 4; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patient seeded with E1-E3, Nursing Home resident seeded with F1-F3

When Edit E1 and delete E2; close the editor, reload, reopen; type a note and Save Note; reopen. Same in Nursing Home on the tab with F1/F2

Then After each transition: Hospital [E1', E3], Nursing Home [F1', F3]; the deleted point is absent after reload and after Save Note; the edited text is not reverted

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Checkpoints (mustNotContain the deleted text and the pre-edit wording) plus backendChecks after the run: Hospital texts == ['Recheck lactate at 2 pm', 'Daughter visits at 6 pm'] and Nursing Home == ['Weigh Mon and Thu', 'Skin check: left heel'] exactly (U4, U3, T3, T5)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-12 Important Points · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-12/S07
